(BAND VERSION)]] (bonus track)''' ==Trivia== * "The Legendary Beasts" and a portion of "Ruler of Illusions" are both versions of "{{mov|Entei|Entei's|03}} Theme" from [[M03|the third movie]]'s soundtrack, ''[[Emperor of the Crystal Tower: Entei Music Collection]]'', in its first reappearance in a decade. * "The Town Where Celebi Arrives", "The Grace of Celebi", and "Celebi's Blessing" are remix versions of "{{OBP|Celebi|M04}} Revived" from [[M04|the fourth movie]]'s soundtrack, ''[[Celebi: Encounter Beyond Time Original Soundtrack]]''. * This is the first movie soundtrack release to include every single track that played in the movie, leaving nothing unreleased. {{stub|Music}} ==Related articles== {{M13 navbox}} {{Japanese CDs}}
